units.source_text: 后来二女公子说道：“古人有‘尘世繁华多苦患……’之诗。

en.t: Later the Second Princess said, "The ancients have a poem that says, 'The prosperity of this dusty world brings many sufferings...'

units.source_text: 我身居山乡之时，并未特地将尘世和山乡两相比较，空过了若干年月。

en.t: When I lived in the mountain village, I never especially compared the world with the mountains, and so I let several years pass in vain.

units.source_text: 现在我很想到山中去过闲静的岁月，但未能如愿，我很羡慕弁君这老尼姑呢！

en.t: Now I dearly wish to go into the mountains and spend quiet, peaceful days there, but I cannot do as I wish, and I envy Lady Ben, that old nun, very much.

units.source_text: 本月二十过后是亡父三周年忌辰，我很想到那边去听听附近山寺的钟声。

en.t: After the twentieth of this month comes the third anniversary memorial day for my late father, and I would very much like to go there and listen to the bells of the nearby mountain temple.

units.source_text: 今特向你恳求，可否悄悄地带我去走一遭？”

en.t: So I earnestly beg you now: could you take me there quietly for a visit?"

units.source_text: 薰中纳言答道：“你不欲使故居荒凉，原是一片好意。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, replied, "Your wish not to let the old residence fall into ruin is truly a kindhearted one.

units.source_text: 但山路崎岖，即使是行动便捷的男子，往返亦甚困难。

en.t: But the mountain road is rough, and even for an agile man the journey there and back is very difficult.

units.source_text: 故我虽然常常记挂，而终于隔了许久才去一次。

en.t: That is why, although I often keep it in mind, in the end I only manage to go once after a long interval.

units.source_text: 亲王三周年忌辰应有佛事，皆已嘱咐阿阇梨举办。

en.t: There should be Buddhist rites for the Prince's third anniversary memorial, and I have already asked the Ajari to arrange everything.

units.source_text: 我看山庄房屋，还是捐献与佛寺吧。

en.t: In my view, it would be best to donate the mountain villa buildings to a temple.

units.source_text: 常去看视而赚得无穷感慨，亦是徒劳之事，不如改作佛寺，倒可抵消罪孽。

en.t: To visit often only to bring back endless sorrow would also be futile; it would be better to turn the place into a temple, which might instead help atone for sins.

units.source_text: 愚意如此，但不知小姐更有何等高见。

en.t: Such is my humble opinion, though I do not know what wiser thoughts you, my lady, may have.

units.source_text: 无论如何，我必遵命照办，务请依照尊意吩咐可也。

en.t: In any case, I will certainly obey your wishes and carry them out, so please command me according to your own intentions.

units.source_text: 万事毫无顾虑地命我办理，这正是我衷心的愿望。”

en.t: To have you entrust every matter to me without the slightest hesitation is exactly my heartfelt wish."

units.source_text: 他又讲了种种家常实际事务。

en.t: He also spoke of various practical household matters.

units.source_text: 二女公子听见薰中纳言已经承办佛事，觉得她自己也应该替亡父做些功德。

en.t: When the Second Princess heard that Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had already undertaken the Buddhist rites, she felt that she too ought to do some meritorious deed for her late father.

units.source_text: 她的意思，是想以此为借口而赴宇治，就此闭居山中，不复出焉。

en.t: Her intention was to use this as a pretext to go to Uji, then shut herself away in the mountains and never come out again.

units.source_text: 此意不免在言语中泄露。

en.t: That intention inevitably slipped out in her words.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便劝导她：“此事千万不可。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, therefore admonished her, "You must absolutely not do that.

units.source_text: 万事平心静气为宜。”

en.t: In all things, it is best to keep a calm and quiet mind."
